register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Get started with StructuredID
register.terms_agreement: By creating an account, you agree to the {terms} and {privacy}

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.totp_prompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
mfa.webauthn_prompt: Use your security key to verify your identity
mfa.recovery_prompt: Enter one of your recovery codes

magic_link.title: Sign in with email link
magic_link.prompt: Enter your email address and we'll send you a sign-in link
magic_link.sent_message: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. The link expires in {minutes} minutes.

device_auth.title: Device authorization
device_auth.prompt: Enter the code shown on your device
device_auth.approved_message: You can now close this window and return to your device.
device_auth.expired_message: The device code has expired. Please start over on your device.

password_reset.title: Reset password
password_reset.prompt: Enter your email to receive a password reset link
password_reset.sent_message: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a password reset link.
password_reset.success_message: Your password has been reset. You can now sign in.

logout.title: Sign out
logout.confirm: Are you sure you want to sign out?

session.expired_message: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
session.concurrent_message: Your account was signed in from another device.
